text: Then all the members looked at each other with terror. They knew the count’s energetic and violent temper; it must be, indeed, a dreadful blow which would deprive him of courage to defend himself. They expected that his stupefied silence would be followed by a fiery outburst. ‘Well,’ asked the president, ‘what is your decision?’ 40206m “‘I have no reply to make,’ said the count in a low tone. “‘Has the daughter of Ali Tepelini spoken the truth?’ said the president.
